items.en: Even though I may not always manage it, I know what I need to do with my child
items.originalArticleTextWithAnnotation: Even though I may not always manage it, I know what I need to do with my child (Knowledge)
items.zh: 即使我不一定总能做到，我也知道自己在与孩子相处时需要做什么。

items.en: I am able to do the things that will improve my child's behaviour
items.originalArticleTextWithAnnotation: I am able to do the things that will improve my child's behaviour (Ability)
items.zh: 我能够做一些有助于改善孩子行为的事。

items.en: I can make an important difference to my child
items.originalArticleTextWithAnnotation: I can make an important difference to my child (Ability)
items.zh: 我能对孩子产生重要的影响。

items.en: In most situations I know what I should do to ensure my child behaves
items.originalArticleTextWithAnnotation: In most situations I know what I should do to ensure my child behaves (Knowledge)
items.zh: 在大多数情况下，我知道应该怎么做才能让孩子表现得当。

items.en: The things I do make a difference to my child's behaviour
items.originalArticleTextWithAnnotation: The things I do make a difference to my child's behaviour (Outcome)
items.zh: 我做的事情会对孩子的行为产生影响。
